subject: Approval request: Two security hires (GRC Lead + SecEng IC3) — comp bands & HC
body:
From: Claire Zhang <claire@talentedge.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security hiring request — GRC Lead + SecEng (2 roles)

Hi Connor,

Thanks again for the brief — we've pushed two strong candidates through initial screens. Quick summary attached (candidate_shortlist.pdf) and a suggested comp band table (comp-band-suggest.xlsx). Details below: 

- Role A: GRC Lead (req 2026-SEC-GRC-01) — candidate: Priya R. (ex-FinServ)
  - Expected comp: base $220k - $250k, target equity 0.5-0.8%
  - Notice period: 4 weeks

- Role B: SecEng IC3 (req 2026-SEC-SE-03) — candidate: Omar V. (ex-cloud infra)
  - Expected comp: base $150k - $170k, RSU 0.1-0.25%
  - Immediate availability (2 weeks)

Attachments: candidate_shortlist.pdf, comp-band-suggest.xlsx

Can you confirm headcount/band approval and whether we should proceed to offers this week? Also confirm if we should route GRC Lead to senior manager panel (recommended).

Best,
Claire Zhang
TalentEdge Recruiting
claire@talentedge.com

----- Forwarded message -----
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Security hiring request — GRC Lead + SecEng (2 roles)

Team — forwarding shortlist from TalentEdge. High-level ask: sign-off on comp bands and headcount for two roles so recruiting can extend offers. Notes:

- GRC Lead: Talent suggests $220-250k base range. This is above our typical L5 band; I propose we classify as L6 (senior IC/manager) for comp and title.
- SecEng IC3: in-band for L5; candidate is strong and available quickly.

Questions for approvals:
1) Do we authorize filling both reqs from current hiring plan?
2) Confirm comp bands as suggested or provide adjustments
3) Any objections to expedite offers this week (we'll need HR/Payroll code & legal to sign off)

Attachments forwarded: candidate_shortlist.pdf, comp-band-suggest.xlsx

Connor O'Brien
Head of Security Recruiting (interim)
Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Security hiring request — GRC Lead + SecEng (2 roles)

Connor —

Thanks for the forward. Quick thoughts after reviewing the shortlist and comp table: 

- GRC Lead (Priya): I support classifying as L6 given her strategic SOC 2 + infra governance experience. Approve the $220k–$250k base range but recommend starting offer at $230k with a 6–8% signing bonus option to reduce counter risk. Equity: 0.5% target, with flexibility to 0.75% based on final panel feedback.

- SecEng IC3 (Omar): Strong fit. I would prefer to cap base at $165k and increase RSU component if needed. Please hold final IC3 offer until Marcus confirms alignment to team capacity — we don't want bandwidth issues.

Also: please include the alternate comp scenario (two-increment offer ladder) in the offer packet — that helps close.

Mina Haddad
GM, Governance & Compliance
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

-----Original Message-----
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Security hiring request — GRC Lead + SecEng (2 roles)

All —

I'm good to move forward on both roles. Per headcount snapshot (attached: hc-snapshot.png), we have two open seats allocated in the Q3 security hiring plan and funds available under budget code SEC-HC-Q3-17.

Action items for Connor/Recruiting:
- Proceed with verbal offer for Priya at $230k base + 0.5% equity; include 6% signing bonus clause as discussed.
- Prepare IC3 offer for Omar at $165k base + RSU ladder; hold formal extension until next Monday so team can finalize interview feedback.
- Loop Legal for background clause and relocation language (if any).

Marcus Lin
Director, Security Engineering
marcus_lin@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Security hiring request — GRC Lead + SecEng (2 roles) — FINAL APPROVAL

Team,

Thanks for the notes and the HQ snapshot. I'm signing off on both hires with the following final directives:

- Priya R. (GRC Lead, req 2026-SEC-GRC-01) — Offer: $230,000 base; 0.5% RSU grant target; 6% signing bonus. Title: GRC Lead (L6). Recruiter may extend verbal offer today.
- Omar V. (SecEng IC3, req 2026-SEC-SE-03) — Provisional offer parameters: $165,000 base; RSU ladder attached. Hold formal extension until Monday for final interview notes.

Budget code for both hires: SEC-HC-Q3-17. Please ensure recruiting includes the standard background + data-access clauses and that Legal reviews the offer language. I'm attaching the signed authorization document for HR (approved-offer-authorization.pdf).

No objections from me — proceed.

Laura Bennett
VP, People Ops (Acting Head, Talent)
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachments: approved-offer-authorization.pdf
